# dsh-plan-build-mode

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A **Plan / Build** mode switcher for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), shaped like opencode's Build/Plan selector.

Two things it adds:

1. **A dropdown in the composer**, sitting immediately to the right of the permission control (`完全权限` / `Full access`). It is always visible and switches the **current** session both ways.
2. **A "Default mode" row in Settings → General**, directly under the permission row. It decides which mode **newly created** sessions start in.

## Why it exists

DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 already ships Plan mode (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode`), but the official composer chip `PlanChip` is **exit-only**:

```js
if (!(plan.pending ? !plan.active : plan.active)) return null;
```

When the session is not in Plan mode the chip renders nothing at all, so **the only way into Plan mode is typing `/plan` by hand** — there is no discoverable entry point. This plugin takes the same seat (`conversation.input.plan`) and supplies a two-way dropdown instead.

## Features

- **Always-visible dropdown** showing the current mode (`Build` or `Plan`) with a chevron.
- **Two menu items with a check mark**:
  - **Build** — implement directly (`/plan off`)
  - **Plan** — plan only, no changes executed (`/plan`)
- **Blue highlight** while in Plan mode (uses the official `--dsw-alias-state-business-*` tokens).
- **Optimistic display** — while a switch is in flight (`pending`), the button already shows the target mode.
- **Default mode row** — pick `Build` / `Plan` as the starting mode for new sessions. The current session is unaffected; use the composer control for that.

## Install

Pin the version, so pnpm's release cooldown cannot hand you an older build:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plan-build-mode@1.1.0
```

Straight from GitHub (no npm publish needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yzhclcl/dsh-plan-build-mode
```

Desktop app: install from the in-app **Plugins** page. The CLI cannot modify `profiles/desktop`.

Then **fully quit and restart** the process serving the profile. The client bundle revision is derived from file metadata (`mtime`/`ctime`/`size`), so a page refresh alone is not enough — a stale revision makes the browser request a URL the server now 404s, which surfaces as `client-modules: bundle script ... failed to load`.

## Use

**Composer dropdown** — click it, pick `Build` or `Plan`. It maps to the shipped `/plan` and `/plan off` commands, so nothing about the plan-mode machinery changes.

**Default mode** — Settings → General → *Default mode*, under the permission row.

> **Note**: the first time you save this row, `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` gains a top-level entry at the end:
>
> ```yaml
> - id: plan-build-mode
>   name: dsh-plan-build-mode
>   config:
>     defaultMode: plan
>   ```
>
> That is the normal `config-editor` write path. Delete the entry (or set `build`) to go back to the default.

## How it works

| Concern | Approach |
| --- | --- |
| Composer seat | `conversation.input.plan` — the `modes` row of the input bar, adjacent to `conversation.input.permission` |
| Shadowing the official chip | `register({ priority: -1 })` — a `single` slot only rejects *equal* priority; the lowest priority renders |
| Reading state | `useProjection("plan")` → `{ active, pending }` |
| Switching | `ctx.remote.commands.execute(sessionId, "/plan" \| "/plan off", [])` |
| Styles | deduplicated injection via `style[data-plugin-css="dsh-plan-build-mode"]`, reusing official size/colour tokens |
| Settings row seat | `settings.general.item` list slot, `id: "default-mode"`, `order: -10` (permission is `-20`, language is `0`) |
| Settings read/write | `ctx.configForms.get("plan-build-mode")` → `remote.settings.mutate(ns, [{op:"set",path:["defaultMode"],value}], revision)` |
| Config field | `z.union([z.const("build"), z.const("plan")]).default("build").volatile()` — only entries carrying volatile fields reach the settings surface |
| Suppressing the auto form | `ctx.inject(["settings"], (child) => child.effect(() => child.settings.configure({ auto: false }, ctx.fiber)))` |
| Pinning new sessions | On `session/created`, if the session is brand new (`seq === 0`, not seeded, no `parentSession`) and the default is `plan`, append `plan/mode` `{ active: true }` — the same first-party event `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode` writes, and one of the names on the persisted event allowlist |

### What "Plan mode" actually is

Plan mode is a **soft, prompt-level** guide, not a sandbox. All tools stay available in both modes; the harness injects a `plan:policy` prompt section that tells the model to explore and plan rather than execute. Real restriction comes from the **permission presets** (sandbox mode + approval policy), which are independent and read no plan state. If you want a hard read-only guarantee, switch the permission preset to Read Only.

Switching mid-turn is supported: the intent is queued and applied at the next turn boundary, while the button immediately reflects the target.

## Compatibility

| dsh | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.0-rc.2` | Verified on Windows, web profile — dropdown, settings row, persistence, and new-session pinning all exercised |

Declared range: `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`. The plugin targets the 0.2.x seat layout (`conversation.input.plan`, `settings.general.item`) and the `plan/mode` event, so older 0.1.x hosts are out of scope.

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plan-build-mode
```

Restart afterwards. The official `PlanChip` returns to its original behaviour immediately — **this plugin modifies no official file**.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: An unofficial whale-girl companion for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar brand mark plus a draggable, collapsible floating mascot with live token usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-whale-girl

An unofficial **whale-girl (鲸鱼娘) companion** for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
She replaces the sidebar brand mark and floats over the page as a draggable,
collapsible mascot: her head follows your cursor, she reacts to pats and clicks,
she follows what the agent is doing, and her speech bubble reports the current
session's real token usage.

![whale-girl](assets/whale-girl-768.webp)

> The character is community fan art, not an official DeepSeek asset — see
> [Source & attribution](#source--attribution). Chinese docs: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md).

## What she does

| Area | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Sidebar brand mark (`sidebar.brand.mark`) | Replaces the stock fish logo with a close-up of her face (`avatar-face.png`). Registered with `priority: -1` so it wins the single-value slot. |
| Floating companion (`shell.overlay`) | A 220×298 paper doll over the frame, with a token card above her and speech bubbles. Drag her anywhere inside the frame (position kept in `localStorage['whale-girl:position']`); double-click returns her to the bottom-right corner and forgets the position; when the window shrinks she is folded back into view. |
| Gaze | Her head turns towards the pointer (up to ±7°) and her tail counter-swings (±4.8°); both settle back to centre 0.22 s after the pointer leaves. The pivot is measured from the eyes/lashes in the art, not from the bounding box. |
| Pat | Press and hold ≥ 350 ms: a one-shot squash-and-return animation plus a dedicated line. She does **not** fold away. |
| Click and combo | A quick click (< 350 ms) folds or unfolds her, with an answering line; 3–4 fast clicks get a counted complaint; the 5th click fires a one-shot easter egg. |
| Mood | `data-mood` follows context occupancy: `<50%` `calm`, `≥50%` `tense`, `≥85%` `crit`. Each crossing drops a 💦 in her corner for 2.6 s. |
| Speech | Lines are triggered by state and filled with real numbers from DSH's own session projections (`tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`): a greeting on mount, an answer on click, live progress while the turn is producing output, a context warning at 80 %, and a "done" line 2.5 s after output stops. She never calls the network or the model. |
| Token card | Context occupancy (bar plus `tokens / window`) and output / input / cache-read counts for the current session — the same projections the composer's own indicator uses. Hidden when there is no session; it yields when the window is narrower than 900 px. |
| Three-layer puppet | Her body, head and tail are separate layers that are pixel-identical to the still illustration at rest, so they are invisible until she moves. |

Animations run only while she is being interacted with: exactly three one-shot
`@keyframes` (`wg-pat` / `wg-egg` / `wg-emote`), no `infinite`, no `alternate`,
no `will-change`; `getAnimations()` is empty when idle.

## Install

The package declares a `dsh.bundle` patch, so installing it mounts both halves —
no profile editing, no manual copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Turanbuturan/dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

`--profile desktop` is the DSH desktop app; use `--profile web` for a plain web
profile. A release tarball or a local checkout works the same way:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

Reload the page afterwards. Host-side changes need a full app restart (Node's ESM
cache pins the module path), but this plugin's host half is empty — a page
refresh is enough.

### Manual drop-in

Copy the folder into `<profile>/plugins/` and add the row to the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whale-girl
      name: "./plugins/dsh-agent-whale-girl/index.js"
```

The path resolves against the profile directory. Removing the `insert` row (and
refreshing) removes her; the folder may stay in place.

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-agent-whale-girl
```

If you used the manual drop-in instead, delete the `insert` row and refresh.

## Build and verify

`lib/client.js` and `lib/client.css` are committed, so installing needs no build
step. To rebuild after changing the art or the skeleton:

```sh
node build.mjs            # regenerates lib/client.js + lib/client.css from the PNGs and layers.json
node verify-bundle.cjs lib/client.js
```

`verify-bundle.cjs` is a structural and behavioural self-check (registrations,
injected CSS, layer geometry, gaze maths, click/pat/combo timing, mood values).
Use absolute paths — the script resolves the bundle relative to the working
directory.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (installable bundle) and `dsh.client.platform = "web"` (browser half). |
| `index.js` | Host half: an intentionally empty `apply()` so the loader can mount the package. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The mount declaration read at install time. |
| `lib/client.js` / `lib/client.css` | Build output: the client bundle that registers both slots, and the stylesheet it injects. |
| `build.mjs` | Builds the two files above from the PNGs and `layers.json` (inlines the art, writes the skeleton geometry into CSS). |
| `layers.json` | Puppet skeleton: crop boxes, rotation origins in the 414×560 art space, amplitudes, measured pivots. |
| `verify-bundle.cjs` | Self-check. |
| `avatar-body.png` / `avatar-head.png` / `avatar-tail.png` | The three puppet layers. |
| `avatar-face.png` | 96×96 face crop used by the 24 px mark and the folded bubble. |
| `avatar.png` | The full-body illustration before cutting. |
| `assets/` | Source art. |

## Source & attribution

The code is MIT. The character art is community fan art and keeps the terms of
the repositories it came from:

- [`Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan`](https://github.com/Neko3000/deepseek-whalechan) — MIT — **the art used now**; cut into layers and background-removed here.
- [`TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl`](https://github.com/TreapGoGo/deepseek-whale-girl) — MIT — the earlier chibi avatar (`assets/whale-girl-avatar-512.png`).
- [`fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon`](https://github.com/fornarwhal/deepseek-whale-girl-icon) — custom terms — reviewed as a candidate icon source, not shipped.

See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for the file-by-file mapping. "DeepSeek" and the DeepSeek
whale logo belong to their respective owners; this plugin is an unofficial
community project.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: This repo is a deepseek harness plugin for routing auto review (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review) reuqests to user specified model
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-review-model-router

Route DSH's experimental **auto-review** safety gate to a model you choose, so a
premium agent model does not pay for its own safety reviews.

```yaml
# <profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: auto-review-model-router
      name: dsh-auto-review-model-router
      config:
        reviewModel: deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
```

With that entry every review runs on `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash` while the
agent keeps `claude-opus-4`, `gpt-6-astra`, or whatever else the session selected.

## The problem it solves

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review` reviews each gated tool call by
calling `ctx.llm.stream()` on **the session's own route**: it copies `provider`
and `model` out of the session request header
(`snapshotAutoReview()` in `packages/experimental/auto-review/src/index.ts`).
There is no `reviewModel` field in the shipped plugin, so an expensive agent
model is charged for one extra full review request per gated call.

## How it works

The plugin wraps two service methods at activation: `llm.stream` always, and
`llm.prepareCall` unless `wrapPrepareCall` is off.

1. A request is recognized as an auto-review call when it is **hand-built**
   (it does not carry the agent loop's own-request mark) **and** its `system`
   prompt starts with auto-review's fixed `REVIEW_POLICY` opening. Only such a
   request is ever rewritten.
2. It is copied onto `reviewModel`, and the source route's `reasoningEffort` and
   `maxTokens` are dropped. Both are properties of the *agent's* model: a
   reasoning effort the target does not declare makes the harness throw
   `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`, and an inherited output cap can exceed the
   target's limit. Either would fail every review closed.
3. Everything else — the review prompt, its policy system prompt, `temperature`,
   and the `{"risk":…,"decision":…}` JSON protocol the gate parses — is
   unchanged. Only the model that produces the verdict changes.
4. A review that fails transiently is retried on the same route
   (`retryAttempts`, default 4). The gate calls `llm.stream` directly, outside
   the agent loop, so the harness retry plugin (an `agent/request-error`
   listener) never sees a review: without this, one dropped connection denies
   the tool call.

### Why retries need their own classification

Only the codes the harness itself treats as transient are retried:
`EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TRANSPORT`. `TIMEOUT` is deliberately
excluded — the DeepSeek adapter raises it from an **idle watchdog**, so retrying
it multiplies a silent wait by the attempt count while the auto-review deadline
drains. `ABORTED` (the deadline, or the caller cancelling) and configuration
errors such as `AUTH` are not fixed by trying again.

A failed attempt's terminal `finish` chunk is held back: the gate's reader ends
the review on any terminal `finish`, so yielding it would end the review on the
first transport blip. Reasoning chunks stay live (the reader ignores reasoning
content), so a retried review exposes more than one attempt's reasoning while the
verdict is still parsed from the final text block alone.

### Why the wrappers, and not an `llm/stream` listener

Two seams were tried first and both are dead ends on a real runtime:

- Mutating the request inside an `llm/stream` listener throws: auto-review
  freezes it (`deepFreeze`) before streaming.
- Returning `next(replacement)` from a listener never reaches the adapter:
  Cordis's `EventsService.waterfall` invokes the innermost callback with the
  argument list it closed over.
- Writing `ctx.llm.stream = wrapper` is also ineffective: `ctx.llm` is a
  per-read traceable proxy, and its property overlay shadows what you write.

The wrappers are therefore installed on the object that owns each method in the
service's prototype chain (`LlmRuntime.prototype` in practice), which is the one
seam every consumer actually calls. Both are removed when the plugin's fiber
disposes.

### Why `prepareCall` needs its own wrapper

A prepared handle resolves its route during `prepareCall` and then rejects a
dispatch whose config differs from the resolved one
(`INVALID_PREPARED_CALL`). The retarget must therefore happen *before* the call
is prepared; swapping the route in the returned handle cannot work. With
`wrapPrepareCall: true` (the default) a review prepared that way runs on the
review route, and turning it off restores the session route for that path.

## Install

Published on npm as `dsh-auto-review-model-router`:

```sh
# in the profile directory
pnpm add dsh-auto-review-model-router
```

From a local checkout instead, link it:

```jsonc
// <profile>/package.json
"dependencies": { "dsh-auto-review-model-router": "link:D:/path/to/dsh-auto-review-model-router" }
```

Then insert it in the profile patch layer, after the auto-review bundle:

```yaml
# <profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: auto-review-model-router
      name: dsh-auto-review-model-router
      config:
        reviewModel: deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
```

Restart the app: patch-layer changes apply at profile startup.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reviewModel` | `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash` | `<provider>/<model>` every review runs on. An empty string disables routing. |
| `systemPromptPatterns` | the shipped `REVIEW_POLICY` opening | Substrings, or `/regex/u` literals, matched against a request's `system` prompt. Widen this only if a harness release rewrites that prompt. |
| `retryAttempts` | `4` | Retries after the first attempt of one review call, so up to 5 attempts. `0` disables retrying. Maximum 10. |
| `retryDelayMs` | `500` | Pause before each retry. |
| `wrapPrepareCall` | `true` | Also route review requests issued through `llm.prepareCall`. |
| `dropReasoningEffort` | `true` | Drop the source route's reasoning effort on the review request. |
| `dropMaxTokens` | `true` | Drop the source route's output cap on the review request. |
| `logRetargets` | `true` | Log each retargeted review. Retries log a warning regardless. |

## Verify

The test suite has two files. `test/router.test.js` covers the decision surface
with no harness at all; `test/live.test.js` runs the wrappers over the real
`LlmRuntime` and skips those checks when neither this package nor
`DSH_PROFILE_DIR` resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`.

```sh
node test/router.test.js
DSH_PROFILE_DIR=<profile dir> node test/live.test.js
```

Two commands rather than `node --test`: each file runs its `node:test` suite
in-process, while `node --test` spawns a child process per file.

> The plugin patches `LlmRuntime.prototype`, so each live test disposes its own
> mount. Skipping that teardown leaks a wrapper into the next test's dispatches.

At runtime each retarget logs one line, and each retry logs a warning:

```
auto-review-model-router: review request re-routed anthropic/claude-opus-4 -> deepseek-official/deepseek-flash (stream)
auto-review-model-router: review attempt 1/5 failed with TRANSPORT; retrying in 500 ms
```

## Scope and limits

- Only requests recognized as auto-review calls change route. A false negative
  costs nothing (the review runs exactly as before); a false positive is bounded
  to one extra object and one changed route for one hand-built request.
- The standalone `dsh-auto-review` plugin needs none of this: its `reviewerModel`
  config field already sets the reviewer's model directly.
- DSH public APIs are pre-stable. A release that changes the `REVIEW_POLICY`
  opening, `LlmRuntime.prototype`'s method names, or the prepared-handle contract
  needs a matching update here. Detection is configurable
  (`systemPromptPatterns`) precisely for the first case, and the plugin logs a
  warning instead of failing the profile boot when a method it needs is missing.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH handoff plugin: /handoff generates a structured handoff card, auto-numbered new chat, sidebar pinning, threshold auto-prepare.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xwide-handoff

> 给 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 用的交接插件：一条 `/handoff` 把「快聊满的会话」变成「一张结构化交接卡 + 一个干净的新会话」，并在侧栏自动置顶。上下文快满时还能**自动把下一棒备好**。

[![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff?include_prereleases&label=%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC)](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff/releases/latest)
[![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81-beta-orange)](docs/INSTALL.md)
[![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E6%8F%92%E4%BB%B6-blue)](https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

**中文（本页）** · [English](README.en.md) · [安装与使用指南](docs/INSTALL.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

> **状态：v0.2.2 · beta。** 核心流程（`/handoff` → 交接卡 → 新会话 → 自增命名 → 置顶）在作者机器上长期在用；跨机器安装路径（尤其 `childMode: none`）**尚未在第二台机器验证**。安装两步、配置项表、五条故障排查见 [安装与使用指南](docs/INSTALL.md)。

---

## 它解决什么问题

长任务会把会话上下文顶满。官方的自动压缩是**有损**的：它会把细节吃掉，而且压完你还在同一个会话里，继续顶。

这个插件换一条路 —— **交接**：

1. 把「当前做到哪一步 / 改过哪些文件 / 验证过什么 / 下一步做什么」写成一张**交接卡**；
2. 起一个**上下文清零的新会话**，把卡片作为它的第一句；
3. 新会话**自动命名**（`原会话名_01`、`_02`…，落盘计数器，不重名）、**自动置顶**、**自动归入源会话所在的项目分组**。

于是你换了个房间，但接力棒没丢。

## 安装

```bash
# 在 DSH profile 目录里
pnpm add dsh-xwide-handoff
```

**下载即用（不需要 npm / pnpm）**：把本仓库整个目录放进 `<你的 profile>\local-plugins\dsh-x-wide_handoff\`，然后在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾加一行挂载，**重启 DSH**：

```yaml
- id: dsh-xwide-handoff
  name: './local-plugins/dsh-x-wide_handoff/index.js'
  config:
    enabled: true
    commandName: handoff
    childMode: create
    recentUserMessages: 6
```

> ⚠️ **只能有一个装载实例**：包自带 patch 插一条 + profile 再直装一条 = 两个实例（命令注册两次、watcher 双份）。现象是启动日志里 `/handoff registered` 打印两次。详见 [故障排查①](docs/INSTALL.md)。

## 用法

指令菜单里能看到 `handoff` 这一条（说明命令已注册），或在输入框直接敲 `/handoff`：

![DSH 指令菜单里的 handoff 命令](docs/img/handoff-command.png)

```
/handoff 本次重点：把 X 的解析逻辑改完；已改 a.js；未验证回归
```

- `/handoff` 后面写的内容会进卡片的「本次交接重点」。
- **不写也行** —— 卡片会自动带上「本轮动过的文件」和「你最近 6 条原话」。
- 命令执行完会告诉你新会话的 id 和标题，并把它置顶。

**注意**：`/handoff` 是斜杠命令，**只能由用户在输入框敲**，模型不能自己调用。所以插件同时提供 A 半自动（见下），到阈值时**替你把它备好**。

## A 半自动（`autoReady`）

打开后，插件监听每一轮的结束（`turn/end`），读最近一次请求携带的上下文量：

```
占用 = 最近一条 assistant/message 的 usage.inputTokens ÷ contextWindow
```

- **≥ `readyPct`（默认 0.7）** → 自动跑一遍交接：建会话、命名、置顶、注入卡片、驱动它跑完首轮（这样它在侧栏里**一定看得见**）。
- **不替你切会话** —— 你从侧栏点那条置顶的新会话继续。DSH 没有「服务端让浏览器换会话」的公开接口，这是有意的边界。
- 保险丝：同一会话只备一次、全局冷却（默认 10 分钟）、总开关默认**关**。

> ⚠️ 判占用**必须**用 `inputTokens`。`usage.totalTokens` 是累计消耗（见过 20 万），拿它判会 100% 误触。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: dsh-xwide-handoff
  name: './local-plugins/dsh-x-wide_handoff/index.js'
  config:
    commandName: handoff          # 命令名，默认 handoff
    childMode: create             # none | create | fork（见下）
    recentUserMessages: 6         # 卡片带最近几条你的原话
    compact: false                # 交接前是否先本地压缩一次（本地大模型请保持 false）
    titleTemplate: '{base}_{seq}' # 标题模板，支持 {base} {seq} {note} {time}
    seqWidth: 2                   # 序号位数：_01
    maxTitleChars: 64             # 标题字符上限
    repinLimit: 3                 # 自愈重钉次数上限
    autoReady: false              # A 半自动总开关
    readyPct: 0.7                 # 触发阈值（占上下文窗口比例）
    readyCooldownMs: 600000       # 冷却
    contextWindow: 262144         # 上下文窗口（判占用用；默认取自作者的本地模型，请按自己窗口改）
    cardSections:                 # 卡片栏目开关
      guide: true                 # 「接手须知」
      files: true                 # 「本轮动过的文件」
      usage: true                 # 「源会话上下文」
```

### `childMode` 三档

| 值 | 行为 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | 服务端直接建**全新空会话**（上下文清零，继承 cwd 与 agentPreset） | **默认推荐**。不依赖客户端半边 |
| `none` | 服务端不建会话，把卡片 JSON 塞进结果文本，由 `client.js` 用 GUI 原生 API 建**可见**会话 | 需要「和点『新建对话』完全一致」时；要求 `client.js` 已正确作为 `dsh.client` 打进包，**跨机器未验证** |
| `fork` | 继承全部历史（上下文**不**清零） | 只想换个标题、不想清上下文的场景 |

> ⚠️ 三种模式都**不能**带 `parentSession` —— DSH 会把带 `parentSession` 的会话从列表和可恢复集合里排除，那正是「交接完看不见新会话」的经典成因。

## 交接卡长什么样

```markdown
调节Qwen3.8 Agent对接本地模型_07          ← 第一行 = 目标标题（官方取名启发式直接取它）

# 交接卡 · 调节Qwen3.8 Agent对接本地模型_07

## 接手须知（先读这一段）
1. 先读完整卡片：源会话 cwd 下的 handoff/ 目录里最新那份 .md 就是本卡全文
2. 先报计划再动手：一句话说清先做哪条、大约要多久、有没有分支
3. 不要重复已完成步骤：下面「本轮动过的文件」都改过了，先读现状
4. 拿不准就去查证：文件、目录、会话记录都在磁盘上

- 源会话上下文：约 18461 tokens（最近一次请求携带量；判占用看它，不看累计消耗）

## 本轮动过的文件（3 个，自动提取自 5 次 write/edit 调用）
- `C:\…\local-plugins\dsh-x-wide_handoff\index.js`（write×1 edit×4）

## 最近你的原话（逐条原文，按时间顺序）
1. …
```

## 工作原理（给要改代码的人）

- **命名**：序号来自落盘计数器（`~/.dsh/named-handoff-counter.json`，按 cwd 分桶单调递增），**不是**从源会话标题尾号推算 —— 源会话每次都是新开的、标题没有尾号，推算永远得到 `_01`。名单落在 `~/.dsh/named-handoff-names.json`。
- **钉名三通道**：① 卡片第一行就是目标标题（官方取名服务会读它）；② `ctx.sessions.using(...).binding.session.rename()`（部分版本没有 `using`，会失败）；③ `session.append("session/title", …)`。
- **自愈重钉**：官方取名服务会主动覆盖已钉住的标题（其注释自认 "overwriting a pinned user title is the point"），所以插件监听改名事件，发现名单内会话被非 user 来源改名就再钉一次（上限 `repinLimit`）。
- **`prompt` 需要 signal**：`sessionController.prompt(request, signal)` 的包装层第一行就调 `signal.throwIfAborted()`，务必传 `new AbortController().signal`。
- **`blank` 只认 `turn/start`**：侧栏会把 `blank: true` 的会话直接滤掉（标题还会显示成「新建会话」）。注入消息不会翻这个标记，所以必须真的驱动一轮。

## 兼容性

本插件使用了若干 **DSH 内部接口**（不是稳定公开契约），已在下列位置核对过：

| 用到的东西 | 位置（DSH 桌面版内置包） |
|---|---|
| `sessionController.prompt / create / resolveAgent` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` |
| `session.append` 的 `surfaceOp` 语义 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`（`SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES` 只有 system/developer/user/assistant/message + tool/result） |
| `system/message` 必须是 surface 第一条 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4` `foldSurface()` |
| `workspaceRegistry.pinSession` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace` |
| `projectController.baseline / assign` | `dsh-project-groups`（**可选依赖**，没装就跳过归组） |
| 侧栏 `blank` 过滤 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` |

**DSH 升级后请复核上表**。所有内部调用都写了宽容处理：失败只记日志，不让交接本身崩掉。

## 路线图

- [ ] `childMode: "none"` 客户端半边的完整接线与回归
- [ ] 卡片栏目可自定义模板
- [ ] 交接卡自动带上「已跑过的关键命令」
- [ ] 发布到 npm / DSH 插件市场，实现一键安装

## License

MIT © 2026 XWIDE

# dsh-desktop-bun

DeepSeek Harness 的原生桌面壳：**Electrobun（Bun 主进程）+ CEF（Blink/V8）渲染 + Bun 运行 dsh**。

一个安装包，自带 dsh 运行时，开箱即用；macOS（Apple Silicon）、Windows（x64）、Linux（x64）三平台 CI 出包。

## 特性

- **完整 dsh 桌面体验**：会话、插件、托盘、系统通知、防休眠、手机访问（lane 端口）、远程 dsh 接入。
- **多 profile 多窗口**：每个 profile 一个窗口、一份独立服务面；托盘聚焦/开关实例、新建与迁移 profile。
- **运行时管理**：内置随包运行时开箱即跑；也可下载/切换指定版本。
- **稳定的项目隔离**：每 profile 独立端口、独立窗口几何、独立服务进程；壳退出后不留孤儿进程。
- **原生窗口**：系统边框 + 自绘标题栏与三键（macOS/Windows 一致行为），站外链接走系统浏览器。

## 安装

从 [Releases](https://github.com/hyperion2144/dsh-desktop-bun/releases/latest) 下载：

| 平台 | 产物 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple Silicon） | `macos-arm64-DeepSeekHarnessDesktopBUN.dmg` |
| Windows（x64） | `windows-x64-DeepSeekHarnessDesktopBUN-setup.exe` |
| Linux（x64） | `linux-x64-DeepSeekHarnessDesktopBUN-Setup.tar.gz` |

安装与日常使用说明见 [GUIDE.md](desktop-electrobun/GUIDE.md)。

## 从源码构建

依赖：[Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.4+、[hutch](https://hutch.blackboard.sh)（Electrobun CLI）；Windows 安装器另需 NSIS。

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive    # mobile/dsh-mobile-nav（手机布局插件 dsh-web-mobile）来自子模块，漏拉则构建断言失败
bun install --frozen-lockfile
node scripts/prepare-builtin-runtime.mjs --variant latest   # 装配随包 dsh 运行时
cd desktop-electrobun
bun run build        # 产物在 desktop-electrobun/artifacts/
bun test             # 单元 + 黑盒（需要真运行时树时设 DSH_SHELL_TEST_RUNTIME）
```

## 仓库结构

| 目录 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `desktop-electrobun/` | 壳本体（TypeScript / Bun / Electrobun） |
| `desktop-plugin/` | 桌面插件包 `dsh-desktop-bun`（壳 chrome 客户端 + 技能） |
| `plugins/dsh-mobile-access/` | 手机访问插件包（随包 staging） |
| `resources/` | Bun 兼容层（`dsh/bun-preload.mjs`）与图标 |

plugins.readme_text:
# 元冰可 · 企业 AI 资源管理平台

> 🎉 **We just launched on Product Hunt** — thanks for all the support!
> [YBK · Enterprise AI Asset Governance →](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/ybk-enterprise-ai-asset-governance)

[![Product Hunt](https://img.shields.io/badge/Product%20Hunt-Launch-Launch-orange)](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/ybk-enterprise-ai-asset-governance)


[![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![selftest](https://img.shields.io/badge/selftest-1486%20green-success)](https://github.com/01men/ybkkasi/actions/workflows/quality-gate.yml)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node-%E2%89%A522.6-339933)]()
[![i18n](https://img.shields.io/badge/i18n-zh--en--ja-blue)]()
[![Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/demo-demo.ybkkasi.com-FF6B35)](https://demo.ybkkasi.com)

**把散落在企业里的 MCP 服务 / Skill / Agent / AI 应用 / 模型渠道 / SaaS 连接器 / NAS 存储，
统一成一套可管、可算、可审的资产。**

一套身份 · 一套权限 · 一套计量 · 一套审计。**27 个插件包，按需启用。**

> **YBK Enterprise AI Asset Governance** — One control plane for every MCP server, skill,
> agent, and AI app. One identity, one permission model, one metering pipeline, one audit trail.
> Self-hosted, MIT licensed.

**[▶ 免登录在线体验](https://demo.ybkkasi.com)** · **[⬇ 60 秒本地启动](#60-秒跑起来)** · **[📖 文档](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)**

---

## 你可能正在经历这些

- MCP 服务散在各处，**没人说得清谁在用**
- Agent 拿着一把**万能 token 横冲直撞**
- 模型账单月底出来，**没人说得清哪个部门花的**
- 出了数据问题，**翻遍日志查不到审计记录**

元冰可把这些统一成「资产」，**从注册那一刻起就进入治理轨道**。

---

## 这和 AI Gateway 有什么不同

网关把 MCP 当作「一种要路由的流量」；
元冰可把 MCP / Skill / Agent 当作「**要被管生命周期的资产**」——
有状态机、有审批流、有逐工具最小权限声明、能按部门 / Agent / Skill 三个维度出成本报表。

| 层 | 代表方案 | 元冰可的位置 |
|---|---|---|
| AI/LLM Gateway | LiteLLM · Portkey · Higress · Bifrost | 不竞争，管流量路由 |
| LLMOps 可观测 | Langfuse · LangSmith · Braintrust | 不竞争，互补（我们缺 trace 深度） |
| Agent 构建平台 | Dify · Coze · FastGPT | 不构建，只治理已建成的 |
| **企业 AI 资产治理** | **这是一个刚被验证需求的新品类** | **✅ 这一层** |

---

## 60 秒跑起来

**Docker 一键体验**(推荐——打开即免登只读演示控制台):

```bash
docker compose up -d              # → http://localhost:7300(≤60 秒可访问,见演示数据)
```

`docker compose up` 自带 `DEMO_SEED=1 + DEMO_MODE=1`:首启注入完整演示数据,
访客**不注册不登录**直接浏览真实控制台(权限集为 26 个 `.read` 点白名单,
写操作 403/405,页面顶部有「演示模式 · 只读」横幅)。仅在演示实例开启 `DEMO_MODE`
——它会开放实例全部只读数据面,勿接真实业务数据。

**生产部署**(不带任何 `DEMO_*` 变量,行为与源码部署完全一致):

```bash
docker run -d --name ybkkasi -p 7300:7300 \
  -e ADMIN_PASSWORD='你的强口令' \
  -v ybkkasi-data:/app/data \
  ybkkasi:1.3.0
```

源码部署(要求 Node ≥ 22.6,原生 TypeScript 运行,无构建步骤;`node:sqlite` 为 Node 内置):

```bash
npm install && npm start          # → http://127.0.0.1:7300
```

生产基线默认:内置角色 + 根组织 + `admin` 账号(**无任何演示业务数据**)。
`admin` 口令取 `ADMIN_PASSWORD` 环境变量;未设置则随机生成并写入 `data/admin-initial-password.txt`。

想先看效果再读文档:

```bash
DEMO_SEED=1 npm start             # 注入演示数据(组织树/账号/MCP/Skill/Agent/应用/28 天历史)
# 演示账号 admin / ops / hr / dev / audit,口令均为 Ybk@2026
# 追加 DEMO_MODE=1 即开启免登只读演示态(同 Docker 体验形态)
```

企业单节点部署建议开启 SQLite 集合后端(数据完整性 / 内存有界,详见「诚实边界」):

```bash
PLATFORM_STORAGE=sqlite npm start # 业务集合切换 SQLite 后端(WAL + 事务,首启自动回填既有 JSON 数据)
```

```bash
npm run selftest                  # 1486 项端到端断言(隔离实例,全绿;含 SQLite 后端契约节)
npm run lint:manifests            # 插件清单五面 YAML 校验
```

要求 **Node ≥ 22.6**(原生 TypeScript 运行,无构建步骤;`node:sqlite` 为 Node 内置,零新增依赖)。

---

## 它管什么

大多数团队现在的状态是:MCP 服务散在各处没人知道谁在用、Agent 拿着万能 token 横冲直撞、
模型账单月底出来没人说得清哪个部门花的、出了问题查不到审计记录。

元冰可把这些**统一成"资产"**,每类资产共享同一套底座:

| 域            | 插件                                                                                                         | 能力                                                                 |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **身份**       | `plugin-iam` · `plugin-authn`                                                                              | 组织树 / 角色 / 用户组 / 三方连接器 · 双轨身份 + OIDC Provider + on-behalf-of 链     |
| **资产本体**     | `plugin-resource-core`                                                                                     | 属性 schema + 生命周期状态机 + 依赖图,所有资产类型的共同底座                              |
| **MCP**      | `plugin-mcp`                                                                                               | 部署 / 灰度 / 回滚 / 健康熔断 / 权限组 / 调用网关 / 监控(真实 HTTP JSON-RPC 传输层)        |
| **Skill**    | `plugin-skillhub`                                                                                          | 提交 → 静态扫描 → 两级审批 → 版本化上架                                           |
| **Agent**    | `plugin-agent`                                                                                             | Agent 本体管理(资源底座 + 机器凭证)                                            |
| **AI 应用**    | `plugin-app`                                                                                               | 编排拓扑 + 应用指标 + 成本穿透                                                 |
| **模型渠道**     | `plugin-modelgw`                                                                                           | OpenAI 兼容真实转发 · 分级路由 · 渠道组降级链 · 预算熔断                               |
| **SaaS 连接器** | `plugin-connector`                                                                                         | open-connector sidecar 数据面:Provider 目录 / OAuth 代理 / 凭证保险库 / 双层授权镜像 |
| **NAS 存储**   | `plugin-nas`                                                                                               | MCP 文件网关通道 / 组织位置 RBAC / 签名下载链接 / Skill 包直传                        |
| **计量**       | `plugin-usage`                                                                                             | 唯一计量入口 · schema v1 幂等 / 死信重放 / 价格簿 / 部门·Agent·Skill 三维聚合           |
| **审计**       | `plugin-audit`                                                                                             | 四类审计日志 + 告警规则 + 成本归集 + 审批中心                                        |
| **流程**       | `plugin-flow-core` · `plugin-exec-hub`                                                                     | 事务流编排 / SLA 与甘特 · 目标树、执行锁 CAS、心跳唤醒、例行调度                            |
| **数字员工**     | `plugin-workforce`                                                                                         | 员工档案 → 任用 → permit 授权 → 受控调用 → 交付验收                                |
| **市场**       | `plugin-market`                                                                                            | 第三方与自营插件市场(契约五面 / Ed25519 验签 / L0 运行时)                             |
| **接入层**      | `plugin-console` · `plugin-panel-core` · `plugin-dsh-bridge` · `plugin-rq-card` · `plugin-dingtalk-bridge` | REST 网关 + 控制台 SPA + 部门工作台面板 + 宿主桥 + 会话执行卡 + 钉钉桥接                   |

**这层的独特性**:市面上的 AI Gateway(LiteLLM / Higress / Portkey)把 MCP 当作**一种要路由的流量**;
元冰可把 MCP / Skill / Agent 当作**要被管生命周期的资产**——有状态机、有审批流、有逐工具最小权限声明、
能按部门 / Agent / Skill 三个维度出 token 报表。这两个是不同的层,不是一个替代关系。

---

## 架构:一切皆插件

运行中的平台就是一棵 [cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) 插件树
(与 DeepSeek Harness 同一插件框架)。每个业务域 = 一个插件包,独立声明依赖 / 权限点 / 事件,可独立启停。
稳定入口见 [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。

```
基础层   platform-core      存储 · 事件总线 · HTTP · ToolRuntime-lite · YAML · 签名 · 场景图谱
底座     resource-core      资源本体:schema + 生命周期状态机 + 依赖图
业务域   iam · authn · usage · audit · market · connector · mcp · nas · skillhub
         agent · app · modelgw · connect · update · portal · flow-core · exec-hub · workforce
接入层   console · panel-core · dsh-bridge · rq-card · dingtalk-bridge
```

**插件协作铁律**:状态变更必发事件;跨插件联动只走事件总线或扩展点(`ctx.platformBus`),
禁止直连对方数据。例如 `iam.user.frozen → authn 吊销全部令牌`、`mcp.unhealthy → 熔断 + 审计`。

### 一份插件代码,两种宿主

- **独立宿主**(默认,承诺 SLA 的形态)——`node src/main.ts` 启动完整平台:控制台 + API + 工具。
- **完整 dsh 运行时**(experimental)——同一批插件挂进 `dsh web`,此时平台注册的运维工具
  **直接对模型可见可调用**:在会话里问「列出所有 MCP 服务和健康状态」,模型会调
  `mcp_service_list`,而不是静态作答。这是"Agent 自运维"形态。

```bash
# 安装形态(推荐发布用)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:01men/ybkkasi

# 源码检出模式(本地开发)——需要把 cordis 指向 dsh 源码树的 vendor/cordis,
# 保证插件与宿主加载同一个 cordis 实例(两份实例会导致 ctx.plugin() 静默失效)
dsh web --patch <本项目绝对路径>/cordis.yml
```

> ⚠️ 宿主形态依赖 dsh `>=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0`。dsh 目前仍是 developer preview,
> 官方明示会有破坏性变更。**独立宿主形态不依赖 dsh 版本稳定性**,是最稳的部署方式。
> 详见 [`docs/host-features-ops-notes.md`](docs/host-features-ops-no

plugins.description: 一级菜单旁添加可供插件接入的“功能”菜单栏，可以快捷添加插件功能，也可以自定义插件功能置入。v0.4.0 现已集成“重启dsh”功能
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-functions

给 **DeepSeek Harness** 客户端顶端加一个可扩展的 **「功能」** 标签：
插件注册进来的一键功能都在这儿，用户不用再记着「去哪儿点 / 输入什么口令」。

> **0.4.0 起这个包自带「重启 DSH」** —— 装这一个包，功能栏里就有「重启 DSH」（两级确认，有任务在跑会拦一下）；
> 不再需要单独安装 `dsh-function-restart`（已并入本包，见下面「一键重启 DSH」一节）。

    [▢]  应用   编辑   功能 3 ▾
                      +----------------------------------------+
                      | 功能                                   |
                      | 插件在这里挂上自己的一键功能           |
                      | 加载功能        让会话去找非官方插件   |
                      | 读取当前会话    让当前窗口的会话读一次 |
                      | 换会话      >   真交接或演练，选一条   |
                      | 插件市场        逛社区插件、一键装     |
                      | 重启 DSH        重启 DSH，让设置生效   |
                      +----------------------------------------+

（示意图来自作者本机安装的一组插件；只装本包时，面板里有内置的「加载功能」和「重启 DSH」（0.4.0 起）。）

**不 patch DSH 本体，不 require React，不引任何 Harness 客户端包** ——
它就是一个普通插件：一行 Loader 条目 + 宿主半边 + 一个自带样式的客户端 bundle。

## 装

DSH → 插件 → 添加插件，填这个包的路径（tarball 或解包目录都行），然后**重启 DSH**
（服务端不热更新；客户端那半边刷新页面就有）。

手动装也行：profile 的 `package.json` 里加一条依赖 + `dsh.profile.bundles` 一行，
再在 `node_modules` 里放一个指向它的 Junction/软链。

装好后插件页会用它包里的展示元数据（`locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` 里的
`meta.title` / `meta.description`）显示标题与描述，并显示包内的 `icon.svg`。
`package.json` 里对应的是顶层 `icon` 字段、`exports` 里的 `./locale/*.json`，
以及 `files` 里的 `locale/*.json` 与 `icon.svg`（0.3.1 起；0.4.0 起还带 `restart/` 的
图标与 locale，见下面「一键重启 DSH」一节）。

## 五行加一条功能（宿主半边，推荐）

    // 你自己的插件 index.js
    export const inject = ['functions'];

    export function apply(ctx) {
      ctx.functions.register({
        id: 'my.tool',
        title: '干点什么',
        description: '一句话说明\n它调用的插件名',   // 第二行惯例：写它依赖的插件
        group: '我的',
        order: 10,
        confirm: { title: '干点什么', message: '现在跑？' },
        async run() { return { message: '干完了' }; },
      });
    }

`run()` 返回的 `message` 会弹在界面上；返回 `{ warnAfterMs, warnMessage }` 的话，
到点还活着就再弹一条（给「重启这种会把自己关掉的功能」兜底）。

## 字段表

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | **必填**，唯一。 |
| `title` | string | **必填**，菜单显示名。 |
| `description` | string | 说明。可以带换行：**第一行讲做什么，第二行写它调用的插件**（面板渲染两行，右对齐）。 |
| `group` | string | 分组，默认「通用」。只参与排序，标签默认不画。 |
| `order` | number | 组内排序，小在前，默认 100。 |
| `pinned` | boolean | **置顶**：永远排最上面（不受分组与 order 影响）。 |
| `parent` | string | 挂到某个父项的子菜单里（二级菜单）。写了它就不出现在顶层。 |
| `submenu` | boolean | 标记这一条是**二级菜单的父项**（容器）：自己没有动作，`run` 可以不写。 |
| `icon` | string | 预留（2026-10 之后面板不再显示单字图标，写了不报错）。 |
| `confirm` | object | 一级确认窗：`{ title, message, detail, confirmText, cancelText }`。 |
| `confirms` | array | 多级确认（静态）。只有第 0 级用得到。 |
| `prepare(stage, context)` | function | **动态**确认：第 N 级的文案在第 N-1 级点掉之后才算（「有没有任务在跑」这种话隔一次就会过期）。返回 `null` = 没有更多确认。 |
| `run(job)` | function | 执行。`job = { id, ctx, log, session, confirm, alert, toast, get, post }`。**不写 run 就必须写 `shell` 或 `submenu: true`。** |
| `shell` | object | 只想跑命令：`{ command, args, cwd }`，结果整理成一句话显示。 |
| `hidden` | boolean | 不进菜单（仍可用 API 调）。 |

二级菜单长这样（照 Windows 右键菜单的逻辑：悬停 120ms 展开、离开 180ms 收起，点父项也能展开）：

    ctx.functions.register({ id: 'family', title: '换会话', submenu: true, group: '会话' });
    ctx.functions.register({ id: 'family.go', title: '真交接', parent: 'family', run() {...} });

## config.functions：不写代码，在 YAML 里加功能（有限制）

本插件还认**自己这一行 Loader config** 里的 `config.functions`，不写代码也能加功能：

    - id: my-quick-actions
      name: dsh-functions
      config:
        functions:
          - id: open-folder
            title: 打开插件目录
            group: 工具
            confirm: { title: '打开插件目录', message: '用资源管理器打开？' }
            shell: { command: 'explorer.exe', args: ['D:/some/plugin'] }

字段与 `ctx.functions.register` 完全一样（见上面的字段表）。

**限制（重要）**：

- 本插件**没有导出 Config**：没有 schema 校验，也没有插件页里的配置表单。
  cordis 会把这一行的 config 原样传进来，所以写错了只在宿主 console 留一行日志，
  菜单里静默少一条。
- **不要为了加功能再 insert 一行 dsh-functions**。同一个插件挂两行会二次挂载：
  `provide('functions')` 与三条同 path 路由都会抛，整个插件激活失败，功能栏直接消失。
  正确做法是在 profile 补丁里按**行 id** 覆盖已有的那一行，把 `config.functions` 写在它的 config 下。
- 只想要一条功能时，更稳的是让别的插件 `ctx.functions.register(...)` —— 有代码可测。

## 三条路由（自己写客户端时才用）

    GET  /api/dshFunctions/list                 列宿主注册的功能
    POST /api/dshFunctions/prepare              { id, stage, sessionId } -> 确认窗
    POST /api/dshFunctions/run                  { id, confirm: 'yes', sessionId }

`sessionId` 是「用户正在看哪个会话」，浏览器那半边会自动带上（读客户端服务 `uiSession`）。
需要往会话里送东西的功能用它 —— **拿不到就拒，别猜**（指令发错窗口代价太大）。

## 客户端半边

功能本质上是「打开某个界面」时（打开设置里某一节、打开某个面板）才用客户端注册：

    window.__ModuleLoader__.load({
      id: 'my-plugin',
      factory(require) {
        return {
          inject: ['functions'],
          apply(ctx) {
            ctx.functions.register({
              id: 'my.open', title: '打开某面板',
              run: async (job) => { /* job.post / job.confirm / job.toast */ },
            });
          },
        };
      },
    });

面板是纯 DOM（shadow root 隔离），升级后最坏是外观退化，不会白屏。

### 顶端标签的定位（Windows 桌面专属，私有契约）

「功能」标签不是官方 slot：它站在 **Windows 桌面应用**原生「应用 / 编辑」菜单的右边，
位置靠量桌面外壳 preload 注入的私有 DOM `[data-windows-menu]` 得到。

- 只在 Windows 桌面应用里存在（`dsh-app://app` 页面）；普通浏览器、macOS 桌面没有这个锚点。
- 当前 DSH 的 slot 目录里没有「窗口标题栏 / 原生菜单条」这种 slot，所以没有官方替代。
  外壳改了这段 DOM，顶多位置退化（最坏挪到页面左上角），面板本身照常工作，不会白屏。
- 加固写法：只有 `<html data-windows-titlebar>` 存在时才按标题栏几何
  （`--dsh-windows-titlebar-height` / `--dsh-windows-menu-start`）停位；量到锚点矩形就贴它的右边；
  其它环境保留 best-effort 位置。位置更新是事件驱动的（属性变化 / 窗口 resize / 启动期有限重试），不轮询。
- 升级 DSH 后请手动点一遍「功能」栏，确认位置与面板正常。

## 内置的「加载功能」

这个插件自己内置了一条置顶功能 **加载功能**：dsh 没有「在工作区新开会话」的能力，
所以它走「把一段指令当成**用户消息**送进当前会话」这条路 ——
让会话里的 dsh 去插件库里找非官方插件、列出数字编号给用户挑，再读 README 把它们接进「功能」栏。

0.4.1 起，这条指令改成**可移植写法**（以前的版本里带了几处作者本机的假设，换台机器会误导 agent）：

- **不写死任何路径**。找 profile 用 `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` 环境变量；没有就按通用位置找：
  Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>`、macOS/Linux `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>`
  （桌面版通常叫 `desktop`）。插件源码放**用户自己的工作区**（例如当前目录下
  `dsh-plugins/<插件名>`），明确说明**不要**放进 DSH 安装目录（升级会覆盖）或 profile 目录本身。
- **装法按优先级给全**：
  1. 当前会话有 `plugin_manager` 工具（创造模式）：用 `install_bundle` 装插件目录的绝对路径；
     **不要**手改 profile 的 `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml`。
  2. 没有 `plugin_manager`：用 DSH 插件页「添加插件」填插件目录绝对路径（官方入口，最稳）。
  3. 实在没有界面入口：才退回 `link:` 依赖 + `dsh.profile.bundles` 一行 + Junction 手动装，
     装完重启 DSH。
- **提醒收尾**：装完宿主半边要重启 DSH（有 HMR 的除外），客户端半边刷新页面。
- **一个非官方插件都没有时**：要求 agent 照实说「没有可加载的」，不要编，可以建议先装插件。

共同要求没变：目标插件目录必须由外部指定（按编号或路径，不猜「最近动过的」）；
接进「功能」栏前先读对方 README；接口拿不到就照实说「没找到」，不编。
确认窗里的第一级一直是「发一条指令进当前会话」，真正发不发由你点「发指令」决定。

指令里点名了下面这一节。

## 一键重启 DSH（0.4.0 起内置）

功能栏 -> 系统 -> **重启 DSH**。两次确认才算数：

1. 第一级交代后果：会关闭当前的 DSH 进程，几秒后自动重新打开。
2. 第二级在点完第一级之后才去查**有没有正在进行中的任务**：有会话在跑、有后台任务在跑，
   就列出来并把确认键换成「仍要重启」（红色）；没有就写「现在没有检测到正在进行中的任务」；
   状态接口没应答时照实说「无法确认」，不假装没有任务。

桌面端的「关闭」本质是强制关：外壳会把主窗口拦下并缩进托盘，所以插件用
`taskkill /T /F` 关整棵进程树。应用带起来的子进程（终端、后台任务、MCP 等）会一起结束，
没有收尾；重启后助手会再把窗口叫到前台。

叫窗口不依赖端口探测：0.2.1-rc.2 桌面版用的是动态端口，新实例端口通常和旧的不一样。
端口只当「早点叫窗口」的快路径（最多等 6 秒）；等不到就固定等 8 秒再叫窗口 ——
第二次启动只会把已经开着的窗口叫到前台，不会多开实例。另有一层安全网：外层把内层助手的
pid 交给它，盯到内层退出后才兜底拉起一次（应用已经开着时同样只会被叫到前台）。

**平台支持：**

| 平台 | 支持 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 桌面版 | 完整支持 | 关整棵树 -> 重新拉起 -> 第二次启动把窗口叫到前台（动态端口下按固定延时兜底）；安全网盯内层助手 pid 兜底 |
| dsh CLI / headless | 支持 | 不依赖 taskkill：本进程按计划退出，助手用同样的命令重新拉起 |
| macOS / Linux 桌面 | 不支持 | 按钮标题带「仅 Windows 桌面版」；点了只说明原因，不执行、不假装重启 |

**不需要再单独安装 `dsh-function-restart`。** 0.4.0 起它已经并入本包（子路径插件
`dsh-functions/restart`），装本包一次就同时得到「功能」栏和「重启 DSH」。
以前装过独立包的：本包启动后会把功能接管过来，独立包看到已有 `restart-dsh` 就不再注册；
确认本包的重启能用之后，把 `dsh-function-restart` 从 profile 里移除，再重启一次 DSH 即可。

**日志**：默认落在 `DSH_HOME/dsh-functions-restart.log`；没有 `DSH_HOME` 就用
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-functions-restart.log`，都没有就落系统临时目录。
可以在 loader 行的 config 里用 `logPath` 覆盖。排查「按了没反应」先看这份日志。

**关闭这一条**：在 profile 补丁里按行 id 覆盖已有的 `functions-restart` 行，写
`disabled: true`（不要新增第二行同名插件）：

    - id: functions-restart
      name: dsh-functions/restart
      disabled: true

这一行的 config 还支持 `initialDelayMs` / `graceMs` / `pollMs` / `waitExitMs` /
`waitPortMs` / `guardDelayMs` / `focusNudge` / `focusWaitMs` / `exitDelayMs` / `dryRun` /
`logPath`，默认值见包内 `restart.js` 的 `DEFAULTS`。其中 `guardDelayMs` 只是安全网开始
接管的延时（之后它盯内层助手的 pid，内层退出后才兜底，不再需要覆盖最坏耗时）。

## 严谨猜测插件接口形式

插件自己多半没为「功能」写接口。接它的时候，最常遇到的不是「接不上」，而是**对方没写文档**。
纪律一句话：

> **推断可以，但必须留下证据链；证据不够就照实说「没找到」，不要编。**

**找接口的优先级**（从上往下，找到就停）：

1. 作者写的 README / README.zh.md / TESTING.md —— 最权威
2. 类型定义与注释（`*.d.t

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a wa_* tool family that lets the agent operate a WhatsApp account through a bundled Baileys bridge.
plugins.readme_text:
# wa-agent

WhatsApp control for the DeepSeek Harness agent.

`wa-agent` adds a family of 46 `wa_*` tools that let an agent operate a
WhatsApp account: connection and pairing, chats and message history, text,
media, locations, contacts and polls, reactions, edits, deletes, groups,
contact book, profile and privacy, presence, and the event stream.

The tools talk to a long-lived **wa-agent bridge** that ships inside this
package. The bridge (`bridge/bridge.mjs`, built on
[Baileys](https://github.com/WhiskeySockets/Baileys)) owns the WhatsApp socket,
the auth state and the message store; it also exposes a loopback HTTP endpoint
for the human-facing QR code. The plugin speaks to it over JSON-lines RPC on
stdio or, when a service manages the bridge, over loopback HTTP.

## Install

One command installs the plugin, the bridge and the bridge's npm dependencies:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/wa-agent
```

On pnpm 11 and newer, that command may stop once because pnpm blocks
dependency build scripts by default (`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`). It names the
packages. Approve them in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run the
same command:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  baileys: true      # preinstall only checks the Node.js version
  protobufjs: false  # postinstall belongs to the protobufjs CLI, not the runtime
```

Restart the harness to load the bundle (the bundle layer is read at boot, not
at install time):

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the add command appends `wa-agent`
to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. That line is the only
activation.

Check the loaded line:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 wa-agent
```

Expected shape:

```yaml
- id: wa-agent
  name: wa-agent
  config: {}
```

No extra step is needed to run the bridge: the plugin spawns it on the first
tool call (`autoStart`, default `true`) and restarts it after a crash. The
first thing left to do is pair your WhatsApp account (next section).

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command, then restart the harness
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove wa-agent   # uninstall, then restart
```

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- **pnpm** on `PATH` (`npm install -g pnpm`); the harness manages profile
  plugins with it.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself, e.g. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.
- **A WhatsApp account you control**, paired by you (see below).

## Pairing

On first run the bridge has no session and shows a QR. With the default
`httpPort: 29141`:

1. Open <http://127.0.0.1:29141/qr.png>.
2. In the phone, open WhatsApp > **Linked devices** > **Link a device** and
   scan the QR.
3. Call `wa_status` (or ask the agent) to confirm the phase and the paired
   account.

Alternative: ask the agent for `wa_pair_sms_code` with the full international
phone number. The phone receives a 6-digit code, typed in WhatsApp > **Linked
devices** > **Link with phone number**.

The session is stored by the bridge, never by this package. It is reused on
every reconnect until `wa_logout` is called. Pairing is per account; you pair
your own account.

## Usage

Ask the agent in natural language:

- "What is the WhatsApp status?"
- "Show the last 20 messages from this chat."
- "Send this image to `<recipient>` with the caption `<caption>`."
- "Create a group named `<name>` and add `<participants>`."
- "Mark this chat as read."

Tool groups:

| Group | Tools |
|---|---|
| Connection | `wa_status`, `wa_pair`, `wa_pair_sms_code`, `wa_restart`, `wa_logout` |
| Chats and messages | `wa_chats`, `wa_chat_messages`, `wa_send_text`, `wa_edit_message`, `wa_send_media`, `wa_send_location`, `wa_send_contact`, `wa_send_poll`, `wa_send_reaction`, `wa_pin_message`, `wa_delete_message`, `wa_forward_message`, `wa_download_media`, `wa_mark_read`, `wa_chat_modify` |
| Groups | `wa_groups`, `wa_group_info`, `wa_group_create`, `wa_group_join`, `wa_group_update`, `wa_group_participants`, `wa_group_settings`, `wa_group_invite`, `wa_group_approvals`, `wa_group_leave` |
| Contacts | `wa_contacts`, `wa_contacts_allow`, `wa_contacts_clear`, `wa_phone_check`, `wa_peer_info`, `wa_block_user`, `wa_blocklist`, `wa_save_contact` |
| Account | `wa_profile`, `wa_profile_update`, `wa_profile_picture`, `wa_privacy_get`, `wa_privacy_set`, `wa_status_post` |
| Events | `wa_events` |

Sends are per recipient. The plugin adds no mass-messaging, scraping or
follower-growth surface.

## Bridge resolution

The plugin looks for the bridge in this order:

1. an explicit deployment: `bridgeDir` in the plugin config, or the
   `WA_WORKSPACE` environment variable. The directory may hold `bridge.mjs`
   directly, or a workspace that holds `wa-agent/bridge.mjs`.
2. the bridge bundled in this package: `bridge/bridge.mjs`.
3. a historical standalone deployment under `~/wa-agent` (`bridge.mjs` or
   `wa-agent/bridge.mjs`).

Set `bridgeDir` (or `WA_WORKSPACE`) to keep using a bridge you already run.
When it is set, it is authoritative: a missing file fails with
`WA_BRIDGE_MISSING` instead of silently starting the bundled bridge against a
different state directory. When it is not set, the bundled bridge is used, with
its runtime root at your home directory, so state lives in `~/wa-agent/`.

## Configuration

Every path is configurable; the defaults derive from your home directory. A
patch replaces the whole config of the line, so restate every key you want to
keep.

| Key | Environment | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bridgeDir` | `WA_WORKSPACE` | bundled bridge | bridge deployment directory; also the runtime root for state |
| `dataDir` | | `<root>/wa-agent/data` | WhatsApp auth-state directory override |
| `mediaDir` | | `<root>/wa-agent/media` | downloaded-media directory override |
| `httpPort` | | `29141` | loopback port for QR, health and RPC; `0` disables HTTP |
| `autoStart` | | `true` | spawn the bridge on demand and restart it after a crash |
| `rpcTimeoutMs` | | `120000` | per-RPC timeout |

Profile patch example (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: wa-agent
  config:
    bridgeDir: '/absolute/path/to/wa-agent'
    httpPort: 29141
```

Use an absolute path in the config; `~` is not expanded by the harness. Leaving
`bridgeDir` out uses the bundled bridge.

The plugin adopts a bridge that is already listening on `httpPort` (for
example, one managed by a service) instead of spawning a duplicate. With
`autoStart: false`, start the bridge yourself before calling a tool:

```sh
WA_WORKSPACE="$HOME" WA_HTTP_PORT=29141 \
  node "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/wa-agent/bridge/bridge.mjs"
```

## Troubleshooting

- **`pnpm not found on PATH`** — `npm install -g pnpm`, then re-run the add
  command.
- **`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`** — pnpm ≥ 11 blocked the `baileys` preinstall
  and the `protobufjs` postinstall. Add the `allowBuilds` block shown in
  *Install* to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run the add command.
- **`WA_BRIDGE_MISSING`** — an explicit `bridgeDir`/`WA_WORKSPACE` does not
  contain `bridge.mjs` or `wa-agent/bridge.mjs`. The error lists the paths it
  tried. Unset it to use the bundled bridge.
- **No QR** — call `wa_status`. The bridge may still be connecting, or
  `httpPort` may be `0` (HTTP disabled).
- **Pairing rejected on the phone** — the announced WhatsApp Web version may be
  outdated. The bridge asks Baileys for the current version at every boot; if
  the link still fails, update the package and Baileys.
- **Plugin installed but no tools appear** — restart the harness; the bundle
  layer is read at boot.

## Security and limits

- **The WhatsApp session is a private key.** The bridge stores it in its data
  directory (`<root>/wa-agent/data`, `~/wa-agent/data` with the bundled
  bridge). Never commit it, paste it into a prompt, or copy it into a
  repository. This package ships the bridge code only: no session, no message
  store, no QR cache and no media.
- **The HTTP endpoint is loopback-only.** Do not expose `httpPort` to a

plugins.description: 多模型路由 — DSH multi-model routing plugin: scene-aware model+provider selection, cost-first/speed-first auto-routing, cross-provider failover, two-level menu with favorites. Compatible with dsh-our-free-model.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-multi-model-router **[简体中文](README.md)** | [English](README_EN.md) > 多模型路由 DeepSeek Harness 插件：场景感知的模型 + 提供商选择， > 费用优先 / 速率优先自动路由，跨提供商故障转移，两级套餐·档位菜单。 > > *A DeepSeek Harness plugin for scene-aware multi-model routing with > cost-first / speed-first auto-routing, cross-provider failover, and a > two-level package·tier selection menu.* 纯 META-适配器：注册 `mmr` 路由，暴露虚拟模型（`mmr/coding`、`mmr/cost:gpt-4o`、`mmr/speed:deepseek-chat`）， 其 `stream()` 解析虚拟模型为真实提供商 + 模型后委托 `ctx.llm.stream()` 派发。 不持有 API 密钥、不发出任何出站 HTTP 请求。 --- ## 亮点 - **场景路由** — 定义命名场景（编程 / 翻译 / 搜索 …），每个场景有主模型 + 有序候选链（跨提供商）。 选择场景的虚拟模型（`mmr/<场景>`）即委托给最佳可用候选，在首个正文增量前故障转移。 - **费用优先** — `mmr/cost:<基础模型>` 按费用从低到高自动路由。内置 30+ 热门模型价格表； 未知模型按最贵处理（排在最后，绝不归零）。纯本地，无出站 HTTP。 - **速率优先** — `mmr/speed:<基础模型>` 按速度从快到慢自动路由。内置最小速度探针 （TTFT + tok/s，防假：排除未流出的推理 token）。TTL 缓存 5 分钟。 - **两级菜单** — 第一级选模型（套餐），第二级选提供商（档位）。对话内快捷选择按钮 + 完整设置页。 - **模型收藏** ★ — 收藏常用模型置顶到一级菜单。设置页可拖拽排序。 - **可靠性层** — 分级冷却（限流=短、服务器=中、鉴权=长，指数退避上限 30 分钟）、 健康感知排序（滑动窗口、时间衰减 + 错误码加权）、每步最大切换数约束。 - **跨提供商故障转移** — 正文前失败丢弃缓冲并前进到下一候选；正文后失败以部分输出结束。 兼容 `dsh-our-free-model` 路由。 - **工具配对修复** — 被中断的工具调用在委托前获得合成响应，防止 400 错误。 - **信任围栏** — 优先使用 `connection.admit`（与 `/api` 同级），缺失时回退到回环 + 同源检查。 - **零出站 HTTP、零 API 密钥** — 纯委托层，安全边界不受影响。 ## 架构 ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ index.js (Host 入口) │ │ apply(ctx, config) → registerAdapter(['mmr']) │ │ + webServer /api/mmr/* + emitTopology │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ src/adapter.js — META-适配器 (鸭子类型) │ │ src/router.js — resolveVirtualModel + │ │ orderCandidates + enumerate │ │ src/scenes.js — 场景/虚拟模型定义 │ │ src/failover.js — 链路遍历 + 缓冲+前进 │ │ src/health.js — 分级冷却 + 健康排序 │ │ src/pricing.js — 价格表 + sortByCost │ │ src/speed.js — 探针 + tok/s + sortBySpeed │ │ src/repair.js — 工具配对修复 │ │ src/trust.js — 信任围栏 (admit/loopback) │ │ src/chunk.js — StreamChunk 谓词 │ │ src/store.js — 原子 JSON 存储 (0600) │ │ src/api.js — CRUD HTTP 接口 │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ client.js (Web 半身) │ │ settings.section → "模型路由" 设置页 │ │ conversation.input.right → 快捷选择按钮 │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` 路由器是 **META-适配器**：它注册在 `mmr` 路由下，暴露虚拟模型 （`mmr/coding`、`mmr/cost:gpt-4o`、`mmr/speed:deepseek-chat`）。 其 `stream()` 将虚拟模型解析为真实提供商 + 模型，通过 `ctx.llm.stream({provider, model, ...})` 委托派发。 递归安全：解析出的提供商始终是真实路由（deepseek、our-free-model …），绝不是 `mmr`。 ## 安装 ### 从插件市场 在 DSH 设置 → 插件市场中搜索 `dsh-multi-model-router`，或粘贴 GitHub 地址安装： ``` https://github.com/LiyinAlpaca/dsh-multi-model-router ``` ### 从 GitHub（命令行） ``` dsh plugin --profile add github:LiyinAlpaca/dsh-multi-model-router ``` 安装后重启 DSH 一次。`--profile` 填实际使用的 profile 名称。 > ⚠️ **不要在 profile 目录运行 `npm install`。** DSH profile 是 pnpm-only 环境， > `npm install` 会无视 `nodeLinker: hoisted` 布局并自动安装 peerDependencies， > 导致核心运行时包重复注册、对话不可用。请只通过插件市场或 `dsh plugin` 命令安装。 ### 从本地目录 1. 克隆本仓库到本地。 2. 确保 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 可用。 3. 重启 DSH。 ## 配置 打开 **设置 → 模型路由**： - **场景标签** — 添加 / 编辑 / 删除场景。每个场景有主模型 + 有序候选链 + 策略（fallback / round-robin）。 - **收藏标签** ★ — 切换收藏 + 拖拽排序。收藏的模型置顶到一级菜单。 - **健康标签** — 查看每个候选的健康分、连续失败数和冷却状态。 - **价格标签** — 查看价格表（每百万 token 美元）。 - **速度标签** — 查看速度探针结果（tok/s、TTFT、采样数）。 - **候选标签** — 查看所有已注册提供商的真实模型。 - **设置标签** — maxSwitchesPerStep、healthRanking 开关、customPricing 覆盖。 ### 默认场景 | 场景 | ID | 主模型 | 候选链 | |------|----|--------|--------| | 编程 | `coding` | deepseek/deepseek-chat | deepseek/deepseek-chat, our-free-model/deepseek-v4.1-flash | | 翻译 | `translation` | deepseek/deepseek-chat | deepseek/deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini | | 搜索 | `search` | gpt-4o-mini | gpt-4o-mini, deepseek/deepseek-chat | | 通用 | `general` | deepseek/deepseek-chat | deepseek/deepseek-chat, gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet | ## 兼容性 - **DSH 0.1.5+ / 0.1.7+ / 0.2.0+** — 鸭子类型适配器（无 instanceof）、扁平重试策略、结构性兼容。 - **dsh-our-free-model** — 兼容。路由器的 `enumerateReal()` 包含除 `mmr` 外的所有提供商， 因此 our-free-model 路由是可选候选。无冲突（不同提供商路由）。 - **Node 22.19+ / 24+** ## 测试 ```bash node test/failover.test.mjs # 45 tests — 链路遍历、缓冲+前进、失败分类 node test/health.test.mjs # 23 tests — 分级冷却、健康分、排序 node test/pricing.test.mjs # 25 tests — 价格表、token 估算、sortByCost node test/speed.test.mjs # 26 tests — 探针、tok/s、decodeWindow、sortBySpeed node test/repair.test.mjs # 13 tests — 工具配对修复 node test/api.test.mjs # 26 tests — CRUD、信任围栏、404 node test/smoke.test.mjs # 21 tests — apply() + 适配器契约 + 委托 # Total: 179 tests, 0 failures ``` 全部离线执行，不出网、不消耗任何模型额度。 ## 安全与隐私 - 所有状态写入 `DSH_HOME/multi-model-router/settings.json`（权限 0600），不上传至任何位置。 - 路由器不持有 API 密钥、不发出任何出站 HTTP 请求。每次调用都委托给其他已注册适配器的 `ctx.llm.stream`。 - 插件 HTTP 路由（`/api/mmr/*`）带信任围栏：优先使用 composition 的 `connection.admit`（与内核 `/api` 同级）， 缺失时回退到结构化围栏（回环 Host + 同源 Origin 检查）。 - 请求体上限 1 MB（413 拒绝）。 ## 许可证 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 本项目为独立插件，与任何模型提供方无隶属、认可或赞助关系。 ## 致谢 - [dsh-our-free-model](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model) — 降级链 + 故障转移引擎（MIT）， 本路由器的链路遍历和"缓冲到首答"模式基于其实现。 - [dsh-model-router](https://github.com/welsione/dsh-model-router) — 分级冷却 + 健康感知排序 + maxSwitchesPerStep 可靠性层。 - [dsh-model-router (Alice-Marx)](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-model-router) — 费用效用公式（costUtility = 1/(1+C/C_ref)）。 - [dshelm](https://github.com/Altairpaca/dshelm) — 策略解析 + 证据评分概念。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that checks whether a voice note's transcript matches its audio (EmbeddingGemma cosine in a shared 768-d space) and searches the audio by meaning.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-escutar

A voice note has two records: the audio and the transcript. When the transcript
is wrong (wrong language, noise, text from another note), the mistake enters the
conversation silently. This plugin measures how far the transcript is from the
audio in the shared 768-dimensional space of EmbeddingGemma, and lets you search
the audio by meaning even when the transcript cannot be trusted.

It never transcribes again, never deletes and never rewrites a transcript: it
reads, measures and warns. Audio never leaves your machine.

## Install

Works on Linux, macOS and Windows. Open a terminal (PowerShell is fine on
Windows) and run:

```sh
# 1. pnpm — the harness manages profile plugins with it
npm install -g pnpm

# 2. add the plugin to your `web` profile
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-escutar

# 3. restart the harness: the bundle layer is read at boot
#    stop `dsh web` (Ctrl+C) and start it again
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-escutar`.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` also appends the
plugin row to the profile bundle list. That row is the only activation, and it
is applied at every boot. Nothing else to configure to install.

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command above (it resolves the repository again), then restart
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-escutar   # then restart
```

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the same range DeepSeek Harness supports).
- **pnpm** on `PATH` — the harness uses it to manage profile plugins.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself.
- **EmbeddingGemma CLI** reachable as an executable. The plugin calls
  `parecido <audio> <text> --simetrico` and
  `buscar <query> --indice <collection> --n <n>`. Point it with the
  `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN` environment variable or the `gemma` config key. If the
  binary is missing, the first measurement answers with an error naming that
  variable; the rest of the harness is unaffected.
- **A voice corpus**: one audio file and one transcript per note, sharing the
  id (`001.ogg` + `001.md`), either side by side or split into `audio/` and
  `texto/`.

The plugin itself has no native dependencies and no build step: plain ESM using
only Node built-ins.

## Usage

| Who | How | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| the agent | `conferir_transcricao` tool | check one note (`id`) or search the audio by meaning (`consulta`) |
| you | `/escutar` command | recent notes with a suspicious transcript |
| the agent | `agent/pre-step` hook | a short warning at the end of the conversation when a recent note is suspicious; nothing is appended when there is no suspicion, so it costs zero tokens |

```text
conferir_transcricao { "id": "001" }                               # is this note trustworthy?
conferir_transcricao { "consulta": "what did I say about backup" } # search the audio
/escutar                                                           # recent suspicious notes
```

### Verdicts

The verdict is the cosine between the audio vector and the transcript vector:

| Verdict | When |
|---|---|
| `suspeita` | cosine < **0.78** − 0.03 |
| `incerta` | inside the 0.03 band around the threshold |
| `confiavel` | cosine > 0.78 + 0.03 |
| `sem-medida` | no number (CLI failure, corrupt cache) |

A note on the edge of the threshold is reported as `incerta` on purpose: it is
neither an alarm nor a pass.

## Configuration

Every key falls back to a default, so a wrong config never breaks the plugin.
Override the row by `id` in your profile patch
(`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`; on Windows,
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`). A patch **replaces the
whole config of the row**, so restate every key you want to keep:

```yaml
- id: escutar
  config:
    corpus: '/path/to/voice-corpus'
    cache: '/path/to/discordancia.json'
    gemma: '/path/to/embeddinggemma'
    limiar: 0.78
    banda: 0.03
    maxAvisos: 2
    colecaoAudio: 'escutar-audio-gemma-v1'
    tempoLimiteMs: 120000
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `workspace` | package directory | base for the `corpus` and `cache` defaults |
| `corpus` | `<workspace>/corpus` | folder with the audio/transcript pairs |
| `cache` | `<workspace>/estado/discordancia.json` | cache read by `/escutar` and the hook |
| `gemma` | `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN`, then `~/.local/bin/embeddinggemma` (`embeddinggemma.exe` on Windows) | EmbeddingGemma CLI |
| `limiar` | `0.78` | cosine below which the transcript is suspicious |
| `banda` | `0.03` | uncertainty margin around the threshold |
| `maxAvisos` | `2` | maximum lines the hook appends; `0` disables it |
| `colecaoAudio` | `escutar-audio-gemma-v1` | index name used by `consulta` |
| `tempoLimiteMs` | `120000` | timeout for one CLI call |

The `DSH_ESCUTAR_GEMMA_BIN` variable is used when `gemma` is not set in the
config. The package carries no machine-specific path.

### Index and cache

The plugin reads two artifacts; it does not build them:

1. **Audio index** (`colecaoAudio`, default `escutar-audio-gemma-v1`) — needed
   only by `conferir_transcricao` with `consulta`. Build it with the
   EmbeddingGemma CLI:

   ```sh
   embeddinggemma indexar /path/to/corpus/audio \
     --nome escutar-audio-gemma-v1 --ext ogg,opus,mp3,wav,m4a
   ```

   The audio encoder reads roughly the first 30 seconds of each file. If you
   need long notes sliced into windows, slice them before indexing.

2. **Discordance cache** (`cache`) — needed by `/escutar` and the hook. It is a
   JSON file written by your indexing pipeline:

   ```json
   {
     "gerado_em": "2026-10-13T12:00:00+00:00",
     "notas": [
       {
         "id": "001",
         "cosseno": 0.84,
         "transcricao": "first 200 characters of the transcript",
         "mtime": "2026-10-13T11:59:00+00:00",
         "mtime_texto": "2026-10-13T11:59:00+00:00",
         "janelas": [0.84],
         "segundos": 12
       }
     ]
   }
   ```

   `mtime` and `mtime_texto` are the modification times of the audio and the
   transcript when the cosine was measured. The tool checks them on every read:
   a cache without them, or older than the files on disk, is not served as
   current — the note is measured again on the spot. The hook only warns about
   notes whose `mtime` is within the last 48 hours.

Without an index or a cache, `conferir_transcricao` with `id` still works: it
measures the pair live (about 11 s to load the model, plus a few seconds per
note). `/escutar` and the hook stay quiet and say what is missing.

## Verification

After the restart, dump the profile config and look for the row:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

```text
# == dsh-escutar
- id: escutar
  name: dsh-escutar
```

Then ask the agent to call `conferir_transcricao` with `{"id": "001"}` (or run
`/escutar` when the cache exists). A live measurement returns the cosine, the
verdict and the transcript read from the cache.

From a source checkout, run the test suite:

```sh
npm test
```

The suite covers the verdict band, the CLI output parser, the cache freshness
guards, the command, the hook and the missing-binary error. It uses shell stubs,
so it runs on Linux and macOS; installing the plugin does not depend on it.

## Limits

- **The audio encoder reads about 30 seconds.** A long note is judged by a
  window, not by the whole recording.
- **A plausible but wrong transcript can pass.** Swapping one word for another
  word on the same subject may not move the cosine below the threshold. The
  signal catches gross errors: wrong language, noise, text from another note.
- **It does not judge the content.** It only says whether the audio and the text
  talk about the same thing in the same semantic space.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a personal agenda of Markdown cards (tasks, ideas, notes, projects) with seven agent tools, a sidebar tab and a daily digest. The data never lives in the plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agenda

A personal agenda of Markdown cards, inside
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Tasks, ideas, notes and projects live as plain Markdown files with YAML
frontmatter in a directory you own. The agent captures what you say, answers
what is due, and changes a card only with the `etag` it just read. You get a
sidebar tab, a chat command and a short digest at the start of every turn. The
data never lives inside the plugin: uninstalling it leaves every card intact and
readable.

| Who | How | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| the agent | seven `agenda_*` tools | capture, search, read, update, close, the day's digest, reminders |
| you, in the chat | `/agenda [hoje \| capturar <texto> \| buscar <termo>]` | the digest or a capture without leaving the conversation |
| you, in the sidebar | **Acervo** tab and the **anotar** shortcut | filters, the card detail and the day-to-day actions |
| you, in Settings | **Acervo** section | the `agenda.yml` parameters, the tag vocabulary and the model reference |

## Install

```sh
# 1. pnpm (needed by `dsh plugin`)
npm install -g pnpm

# 2. add the plugin to your `web` profile
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-agenda

# 3. restart the harness: the bundle layer is read at boot
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

If `dsh` is already installed globally, step 2 is
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-agenda`.

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends
`dsh-agenda` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile manifest. That line is the
only activation, and it is applied at every boot.

Check the loaded line:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 agenda
```

Expected shape:

```yaml
- id: agenda
  name: dsh-agenda
  config: {}
```

### Update and uninstall

```sh
# update: re-run the add command, then restart the harness
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:songjongdevsecops/dsh-agenda

# uninstall, then restart
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-agenda
```

## Requirements

- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the range DeepSeek Harness supports). No
  runtime dependencies: the core uses the Node standard library only.
- **pnpm** on `PATH`; the harness manages profile plugins with it.
- **DeepSeek Harness** itself, e.g. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.
- A writable directory for the cards. It defaults to `~/.dsh/agenda` and is
  created on the first capture; see [Configuration](#configuration).
- Optional: the native Schedule plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule`) if you want
  reminders to come back as a turn. Without it, `agenda_lembrar` still records
  the instant on the card and returns the arguments for `schedule_create`.

## Configuration

The acervo root is resolved in this order:

1. `config.acervo` on the `agenda` line of your profile patch;
2. the `AGENDA_DIR` environment variable;
3. `~/.dsh/agenda`.

The default is deliberately neutral: installed from npm, the package lives under
`node_modules/`, and the folder above it is not an agenda. Point the plugin at
your own directory with one of the first two.

Profile patch example (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: agenda
  config:
    acervo: '/path/to/agenda'
```

The same directory can hold an optional `agenda.yml`. The Settings section edits
this file; nothing about your agenda is stored in a harness settings namespace,
so the configuration is versionable, legible and the same file the agent reads.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dia_comeca_as` | `4` | hour the working day starts; work after midnight counts as the previous day |
| `revisar_em_padrao_dias` | `7` | default revisit distance, in days, for an open card with no date |
| `algum_dia_padrao_dias` | `30` | default revisit distance for `algum-dia` |
| `arquivar_apos_dias` | `90` | days after closing before a card is archived |
| `tags` | `[]` | the closed tag vocabulary |

A new tag is refused until it is added to `agenda.yml` (or approved through the
`nova_tag` flag of `agenda_capturar`). A tag in use is refused for removal:
merge it first.

### The acervo on disk

```text
acervo/
├── agenda.yml          # optional parameters and tag vocabulary
├── cartoes/            # one Markdown file per open card
├── projetos/           # cards of type `projeto`
├── arquivo/            # closed and old cards
└── .agents/skills/agenda/SKILL.md   # optional: the procedure the agent follows
```

A card is a file named `AAAA-MM-DD-HHMM-<slug>.md`. The **title is the first
`# ` line of the body**, not a field; the `id` is the start of the file name and
never changes.

```markdown
---
id: 2026-10-09-1432-pagar-luz
tipo: tarefa              # tarefa | ideia | nota | projeto
estagio: backlog
prioridade: media         # none | baixa | media | alta
urgente: false
tags: [casa, financas]
proxima_acao: "Pegar a 2ª via no site da concessionária"
pronto_quando: "Boleto pago e comprovante salvo"
prazo: 2026-10-12
agendar: 2026-10-10
revisar_em: 2026-10-16
criado: 2026-10-09T14:32:00-03:00
atualizado: 2026-10-09T15:02:00-03:00
origem: conversa
---
# Pagar a conta de luz

Chegou a fatura de outubro, R$ 187,40, vence dia 12.
```

**Stages.** Tasks and projects: `refinar`, `backlog`, `fazendo`, `revisao`,
`concluido`, `cancelado`, `algum-dia`. Notes and ideas: `aberta`, `arquivada`.

**Conditions** are orthogonal to the stage: `urgente: true` and
`impedido: { motivo, desde, espera_por }`. **Priority** is a four-step scale
where `none` is a first-class state, and the numeric `ordem` field beats the
label when the day's list is sorted.

**Transitions that require a field.** The core refuses them, not the prompt:

| Transition | Requires |
|---|---|
| `refinar → backlog` | `proxima_acao` (a phrase starting with a verb) and `pronto_quando` |
| `fazendo → revisao` | `pronto_quando` |
| any → `concluido` | evidence from you; the core records `concluido_em` |
| any → `cancelado` | `motivo_cancelamento` |
| any → `algum-dia` | `revisar_em` |

Every write carries an `if_match`. A stale `etag` is an explicit conflict, never
a silent "updated".

## Usage

Talk to the agent:

- "anota: comprar filtro de água" → `agenda_capturar` writes one card and
  returns its id. Capturing the same text again on the same working day returns
  the existing card instead of creating a second one.
- "o que tenho hoje?" → `agenda_hoje` returns overdue, due today, scheduled,
  blocked, stalled `refinar` and overdue revisit, with counts.
- "procura o que falei do filtro" → `agenda_buscar` searches in steps: exact
  filters first, local BM25 scoring when there is text. It never dumps the whole
  agenda.
- "passa o cartão X para fazendo" → `agenda_ler` first (to get the `etag`), then
  `agenda_atualizar` with `if_match`.
- "fecha o cartão X: paguei" → `agenda_concluir`, which demands evidence.
- "me lembra dia 12 às 9h" → `agenda_lembrar` records the instant and returns the
  arguments for the native `schedule_create`.

In the chat:

```sh
/agenda                          # the day's digest
/agenda capturar comprar pilha   # capture without leaving the conversation
/agenda buscar pilha             # search
```

In the sidebar, the **Acervo** tab lists today, `refinar`, `fazendo`, blocked
and all open cards; selecting a card shows its fields and the everyday actions
(start, backlog, priority, urgent, block, unblock, schedule, close). The
**anotar** shortcut in the conversation header captures from the current
conversation. The browser half talks to the host through `/agenda/api`, a
loopback-only POST route, and has no privileged path: it is the same core the
agent uses.

At the first step of a turn the plugin injects a short digest, and only when
there is something to say: what is overdue, what is due today and what waits on
someone else. An empty agenda injects nothing.

## Verification

After installing and restarting, confirm the plugin is loaded:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 agenda
```

Then ask the agent "anota: testar o acervo". A card should appear under
`<acervo>/cartoes/`, and `agenda_hoje` should

plugins.description: 一个大肥鱼插件，用于解决本地上下文太长且未自动压缩导致的报错问题。把每次上下文压缩提炼成 Markdown 交接文档，按对话归档到对应工作区；经 /handoff 与 /memory 命令、memory_search 与 memory_read 工具分页取回，并在可配置压力阈值之上分段压缩。纯 JS、零依赖、无 UI。
